levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Cost, billing frequency, or cancellation steps are guessed rather than found on the actual screen.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The exact cost, billing frequency, and cancellation steps are all correctly found and recorded.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner notes an easy-to-miss detail such as a trial converting to a paid charge or an automatic renewal date.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No yearly total is calculated, or the comparison to a one-time-cost item is missing.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A correct yearly total is calculated and compared to a specific one-time-cost item.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains specifically why recurring charges are easy to underestimate compared to one-time costs.

lookFors: The learner did not sign up for, cancel, or change any real subscription or in-app purchases screen during this task.
The yearly-cost calculation uses the actual billing rate found, not an estimate.

A learner who completed the simulation/equal-credit alternative instead of the real-world version should be scored on this same rubric using the alternative submission as the evidence — using the sanctioned alternative is not itself a reason to score lower.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
